# Scalar Quantity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ScalarQuantity>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/observations`](../../slices/observations.md)

A scalar numeric value with a unit, determinacy model, and granularity — the entity-valued wrapper for literal observation results (temperatures, distances, counts, probabilities). Keeps [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) uniformly entity-valued: the scalar literal lives here, not on the observation directly.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Entity`](gmeow-Entity.md), [`gufo:Object`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-object). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
